default/31603.htm.text: Black Cat: I, kiddo! Ha! Does my calling you "kiddo" offend you? Well, I've lived for undreds of years, so everyone is a kid to me! Heed my words, my young friend! I've never allowed anything to stand between me and my goals, not even decency! But recently, my past evil deeds have begun to haunt my…

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/0-01.htm.text: Black Cat: Are you from the union? Then please, listen carefully to what I'm about to say.

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/0-04.htm.text: Black Cat: You can probably find him hanging around the Fishermen's Guild in Goddard Castle Town.

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/0-06.htm.text: Black Cat: Sometimes I doubt whether anyone will ever bring the power to me. You showed great promise... Could you have really gotten it this time?

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/0-09.htm.text: Black Cat: At last, my lifetime of work has borne fruit! Great job! You've made me very proud. I'll have Bernard announce it to the guild. We have a very special honor to bestow upon you who have overcome such unimaginable hardships. Henceforth you shall be known as an Adventurer!

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/0-010.htm.text: Black Cat: Within your body hides an amazing power, but you are not skilled enough to control it yet. What a pity! Improve your skills and come back. (Only a character of level 76 or above is allowed to transfer to another class. Be careful. You cannot change occupation if you stop Quest!)

Q00079_SagaOfTheAdventurer/0-03.htm.text: Black Cat: All right! Finally, he sent the right person! Klaus is the only one who's ever even come close to achieving it. Alas, he too failed in the end... Now he spends his days loafing about Goddard Castle Town, getting drunk and fishing. He could tell you some things about forbidden power! Here…
